name: Vertico Robot on Track
summary: A 6-axis robot arm on a floor rail that 3D prints concrete elements over 2.5 m high along the rail, for prefab and design work in a hall.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Dutch maker, which offers shipping with on-site installation support and lists 5 printers shipped to Germany and 19 to other European countries (all Vertico models together). No public price.

sellers.name: Vertico B.V.
sellers.note: Eindhoven, Netherlands. Sells the printers directly; price on request. Offers worldwide shipping with on-site installation support.

specs.label: Reach
specs.conditions: robot alone; 3.2 m with the full system

specs.label: Track travel
specs.conditions: 6 m installed length; the catalogue names a 10 m track for the largest setup

specs.label: Power supply
specs.value: Robot 200-600 V, 0.58 kW; pump 400 V, 8.0 kW

specs.label: Software
specs.value: Vertico Slicer (Rhino + Grasshopper) and HMI control stand, licence-free

notes: A complete cell needs a printhead (Accelerator 2K or Standard 1K), a concrete mixing pump (Mai Multimix named) and printable mortar; Vertico says any suitable material supplier can be used.
Stationary industrial robot cell for printing elements in a hall (prefab, design pieces, research); it does not move around a building site on its own.
Slicer software (Rhino + Grasshopper) is included without a yearly licence fee.
Runs on a floor rail; after each print the robot moves along the rail to print the next object.
